title: GuidelineAgentOutput
description: Structured clinical practice guideline output produced by the Guideline Agent

query_summary.description: Normalized description of the guideline search scope

not_found.description: True if no verified guidelines from recognized clinical bodies were identified

not_found_reason.description: Explanation when no formal guidelines could be verified

guidelines.description: Catalog of verified clinical guidelines and consensus statements

organization.description: Issuing professional society, government body, or guideline agency (e.g. ASCRS, ERAS Society, NICE)

guideline_title.description: Full formal title of the guideline or consensus document

publication_or_update_year.description: Year of publication, revision, or official reaffirmation

url.description: Verified URL to the society repository or journal publication

target_population.description: Patient population and surgical domain addressed by the guideline

recommendations.description: Specific recommendation statements relevant to the inquiry

topic.description: Specific topic or intervention (e.g., Preoperative exercise, Nutritional screening)

recommendation_statement.description: Precise summary or verbatim statement of the recommendation

divergence_notes.description: Points of divergence or contrast with other societies

guideline_synthesis.description: Synthesized perspective of overall institutional consensus and recommendations
